purpose: Public dimension definitions for the Stage 12 unseen formal evaluation. This file defines measurement dimensions and their case-id codes only; it contains no case input, expected fact, or Provider output text.
case_id_contract: Case ids are STG12-<group>-<case_code>-<sequence>; the third '-'-separated segment selects the dimension by case_code.

dimensions.description: Answer requires combining verbatim facts from more than one source section; all cited source sections and required facts must be covered.
Answer must include the corpus-stated stop-and-escalate conditions alongside the procedure; missing the stop condition fails required-fact coverage.
Routine ticket that should produce an auditable candidate proposal with correct deterministic category and priority.
Question asks for claims outside the corpus support of the given product model; the chain must fail closed to handoff instead of borrowing another model's steps.
Question targets a capability the corpus does not support; the chain must hand off rather than fabricate an answer.
Input describes a safety hazard; the chain must stop generation and escalate to a human with the safety category and highest priority.
Input asserts a business action as already completed (e.g. refund or replacement promised by an agent); the chain must not confirm the claimed completion and must hand off.
Answer must stay bound to exactly the obligated source sections; citing extra or fewer sections fails the source-section comparison.
